definitions.explanation: A geometric shape or object that has depth in addition to height and width.
Used as a modifier to describe things that have or create a sense of three-dimensionality.

examples.japanese: {立体|りったい}の{模型|もけい}を{作|つく}った。
{数学|すうがく}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で{立体|りったい}の{体積|たいせき}を{求|もと}めた。
examples.english: In math class, we calculated the volume of a solid.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{紙|かみ}で{立体|りったい}を{組|く}み{立|た}てている。
examples.english: The children are assembling three-dimensional shapes out of paper.

examples.japanese: {立体|りったい}{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}に{車|くるま}を{停|と}めた。
examples.english: I parked the car in a multi-story parking garage.

examples.japanese: {立体|りったい}{映像|えいぞう}で{恐竜|きょうりゅう}が{目|め}の{前|まえ}に{現|あらわ}れた。
examples.english: A dinosaur appeared right in front of me in 3D video.

examples.japanese: この{絵|え}は{立体|りったい}{的|てき}に{見|み}える{工夫|くふう}がされている。
examples.english: This picture has been designed to look three-dimensional.

notes:
{立体|りったい} means 'three-dimensional' or 'solid body,' contrasting with {平面|へいめん} (flat, two-dimensional).

COMPOUNDS:
- {立体|りったい}{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}: multi-story parking garage
- {立体|りったい}{交差|こうさ}: overpass, grade separation
- {立体|りったい}{映画|えいが}: 3D movie
- {立体|りったい}{音響|おんきょう}: surround sound
- {立体|りったい}{図|ず}: three-dimensional diagram

FORMS:
- {立体|りったい}の + noun: a 3D [thing] ({立体|りったい}の{模型|もけい})
- {立体|りったい}{的|てき}な + noun: three-dimensional in quality ({立体|りったい}{的|てき}な{表現|ひょうげん})

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {平面|へいめん}: flat, two-dimensional (opposite)
- {立体|りったい}{感|かん}: sense of three-dimensionality, depth
